title: Shipment Tracking Stages, Courier Partners, and Real-Time Delivery Milestones
content: Every shipped package moves through transparent fulfillment checkpoints: 1. Order Received and Packed at Fulfillment Warehouse; 2. Handed over to Courier Partner (BlueDart, Delhivery, Ecom Express, Shadowfax); 3. In Transit through regional sorting hub; 4. Out for Delivery with delivery agent assigned and OTP sent via SMS; 5. Delivered successfully. Callers can track live shipment location using their 10-digit mobile number or last 4 digits of their Order ID.

title: Delivery Rescheduling, Alternate Contact, and Safe Drop Instructions
content: If you are unavailable to receive your package on the scheduled date, you can click the SMS tracking link to reschedule delivery for up to 3 business days later. You can also designate a neighbor, apartment security guard gate, or local courier pick-up center as a safe drop location by providing their name and entering the verification delivery OTP.

title: Cash on Delivery (COD) Rules and Doorstep Dynamic UPI QR Payments
content: Cash on Delivery (COD) is available for eligible retail orders up to ₹20,000. For seamless delivery without requiring exact physical currency change, delivery executives carry dynamic UPI QR codes on their handheld terminals. Customers can scan the QR code with any payment app (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm) and pay digitally at the doorstep before opening the parcel.

title: Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Item 7-Day Hassle-Free Replacement
content: If a delivered item is physically broken, missing accessories, or different from the ordered product, customers can request a replacement or return within 7 calendar days of delivery. Reverse pickup from your doorstep is completely free of charge. Once the delivery agent collects the returned item, a brand-new replacement is dispatched within 24 hours.

title: Pre-Dispatch Order Cancellation and Instant UPI Refund Crediting
content: Orders can be cancelled with one click inside the mobile app or via telephone IVR at zero cancellation penalty as long as the order status remains in 'Processing' or 'Packed' prior to courier dispatch. For prepaid orders paid via UPI or digital wallets, 100% of the funds are refunded instantly back to the originating bank account within 2 hours.

title: Delivery Executive Masked Calling and Contact Privacy
content: On the day of scheduled delivery, when the status changes to 'Out for Delivery', the customer can contact their designated courier delivery executive through a privacy-protected masked telephone number in the app. The delivery driver's real phone number and the customer's personal mobile number are mutually masked to protect personal privacy.

title: Failed Delivery Attempts, Customer Unavailability, and Return to Origin (RTO)
content: If the recipient is unavailable or unreachable on the day of delivery, the courier partner will make up to 3 delivery attempts on consecutive business days. SMS alerts are sent after each attempt with an option to reschedule. If delivery fails after 3 attempts, the package is marked Return to Origin (RTO), and a 100% automatic refund is initiated upon warehouse check-in.

title: Open-Box Delivery Protocol for High-Value Electronics and Laptops
content: For valuable electronics, smartphones, televisions, and laptops, Open-Box Delivery is mandatory. The courier delivery associate unboxes the outer protective packaging in front of the customer to inspect the device screen, check for physical transit dents, and verify all inbox accessories. Once the customer verifies the physical integrity of the product, they share the delivery OTP to complete handover.

title: GST Invoicing, Order Invoices, and Official Brand Warranty Claims
content: A tax-compliant GST invoice is generated automatically upon shipment and remains permanently downloadable as a PDF under Order History. This official invoice serves as valid proof of purchase for claiming manufacturer brand warranty across authorized brand service centers anywhere in India for 1 to 2 years.

title: Delivery Address and Pincode Correction Post-Order Placement
content: Customers who notice a minor typo in their house number, floor, or landmark can edit the shipping address within 2 hours of order placement directly inside the app. Once a package has been labeled and handed over to the courier partner with a master AWB number, state and city pincode changes cannot be altered mid-transit for logistics routing reasons.

title: Manufacturer Brand Warranty Coverage Beyond 7-Day Return Period
content: Once the 7-day initial return and replacement window expires, all hardware products are covered by manufacturer warranty ranging from 12 to 36 months. Customers can locate the nearest authorized service center on the brand portal or contact customer care to book a free in-home technician visit for large appliances.

title: Shipment Stuck in Transit or Lost by Courier Partner Resolution SLA
content: If a dispatched courier tracking status remains static with no scan movement for 4 consecutive business days, the logistics tracking system flags the consignment as potentially lost in transit. Customer support initiates an automated carrier investigation; if the package is confirmed lost, a priority replacement is dispatched immediately or a 100% refund is processed within 24 hours.
